manifest.name: STARBOX COFFEE: Coffee Rising
manifest.description: CLIMB. COLLECT. BREW. Circle a giant cup as a pixel barista, leap up spiral steps and outrun rising coffee. Order Espresso or Latte; collect every recipe ingredient for Perfect Coffee. Free arcade play, instant retries and collectible drink cards.

credits.work: STARBOX architecture, pixel barista, cards and arcade sound effects
credits.by: Original procedural artwork and synthesis created for this experience
